The tutor successfully covered all must_cover points across the three turns, correctly affirmed the student's 'pump' analogy in Turn 2 without repeating the full explanation, and accurately explained the role of red blood cells/iron in Turn 3.

In Turn 3, it failed to address the light/gravity directionality correctly. Most critically, Turn 3 re-explained the stem's function as a 'bridge' which was already explained in Turn 1, triggering the hard cap on pedagogy for repetition.
